notes: The determiner 'an' before 'eloquent man' is placed on ἀνήρ under rule 58, the determiner determining the noun phrase rather than the attributive adjective, discontinuously under rule 15.
ὤν takes 'and he was' as a participial copula converted into a coordinate finite clause; rule 53's predicate-adjective clause is not in play because the copula is expressed in Greek.
τῷ before γένει is unrepresented under rule 23 with 'by' staying on the noun per rule 21, as 18:2 reads the same phrase.
